sentences.text: Caitlyn Marie Jenner -LRB- born October 28 , 1949 -RRB- , formerly known as Bruce Jenner , is an American television personality and retired Olympic gold medal-winning decathlete .	television personality	television personality	Olympic	Olympic Games	gold medal	Olympic medal	decathlete	Decathlon

Jenner was a college football player for the Graceland Yellowjackets before incurring a knee injury that required surgery .	Graceland Yellowjackets	Graceland Yellowjackets	college football	college football

Coach L. D. Weldon , who had coached Olympic decathlete Jack Parker , convinced Jenner to try the decathlon .	Olympic	Olympic Games	decathlete	Decathlon	Jack Parker	Jack Parker (decathlete)	decathlon	decathlon

After intense training , Jenner won the 1976 Olympics decathlon event at the Montreal Olympic Games , gaining fame as `` an all-American hero '' .	Olympic	Olympic Games	decathlon	decathlon	1976 Olympics decathlon	Athletics at the 1976 Summer Olympics – Men's decathlon	Montreal Olympic Games	Montreal Summer Olympics
Jenner set a third successive world record while winning the Olympics .
The winner of the Olympic decathlon is traditionally given the unofficial title of `` world 's greatest athlete '' .	Olympic	Olympic Games	decathlon	decathlon
With that stature , Jenner subsequently established a career in television , film , writing , auto racing , business and as a Playgirl cover model .	auto racing	auto racing	Playgirl	Playgirl
Jenner has six children from marriages to wives Chrystie Crownover , Linda Thompson , and Kris Jenner .	Linda Thompson	Linda Thompson (actress)	Kris Jenner	Kris Jenner

Since 2007 , Jenner has appeared on the reality television series Keeping Up with the Kardashians with Kris , their daughters Kendall and Kylie Jenner , and step-children Kourtney , Kim , Khloé , and Rob Kardashian .	Keeping Up with the Kardashians	Keeping Up with the Kardashians	Kendall	Kendall Jenner	Kylie	Kylie Jenner	reality television	reality television	Kylie Jenner	Kylie Jenner	Kourtney	Kourtney Kardashian	Kim	Kim Kardashian	Khloé	Khloé Kardashian	Rob Kardashian	Rob Kardashian

Previously identifying publicly as male , Jenner revealed her identity as a trans woman in April 2015 , publicly announcing her name change from Bruce to Caitlyn in a July 2015 Vanity Fair cover story .	trans woman	trans woman	Vanity Fair	Vanity Fair (magazine)
Her name and gender change became official on September 25 , 2015 .
She has been called the most famous openly transgender woman in the world .	transgender	transgender

From 2015 to 2016 , Jenner starred in the reality television series I Am Cait , which focused on her gender transition .	I Am Cait	I Am Cait	reality television	reality television	gender transition	gender transition
